posts.caption:

posts.title: Beating the Winter Blues in Utah: Short Days, Inversions and Staying Connected
posts.caption:
Dark when you leave for work. Dark when you get home. Gray for days under the inversion.

If you feel a little flat, tired or disconnected during a Utah winter, you are far from alone. Our guide covers why winter can hit hard here, simple ways to get more light and movement into your days, and why staying connected with friends matters so much.

It also explains how to tell when the winter blues might be something more, and when to talk to a health care provider.

Put one standing date with a friend on the calendar. Read the guide, link in bio. If you're in immediate distress, call or text 988.

This is general information, not medical advice.
